title: Uruguayan-Style Jagged Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup made with jagged noodles, fideo, and uruguayan spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add fideo and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Add jagged noodles, vegetable broth, and uruguayan seasoning.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
